Could you please share the specific compilation commands you used so I can see if I can reproduce the bug on my own machine? Thank you.

The issue doesn't occur when using `--gpu-index 1` to use llvmpipe. Several data races are still reported, but there's no crash.

> Could you please share the specific compilation commands you used so I can see if I can reproduce the bug on my own machine? Thank you.

Use `scons use_tsan=yes` then run the compiled binary (which has a `.san` suffix) with `--rendering-driver vulkan` (to force the project manager to use Vulkan instead of OpenGL). You'll probably also want to pass `use_llvm=yes` as well to SCons to use Clang instead of GCC, which works better with sanitizers from my testing (the binary will have a `.llvm.san` suffix).
